title: The dashboard's Recent activity card got slow as data grew
scenario: The learner dashboard's Recent activity query takes 1.5-4 s on 41M quiz attempts and Cloud SQL CPU is 80-90%. The query has not changed since July; VACUUM ANALYZE changed nothing. You get Query Insights, a PostgreSQL plan, the migrations and a 200k-row local copy (SQLite, same plan shapes).
task: Explain from the plans why the existing index does not help
Rule vacuum and buffers in or out
Add an additive V7 index and fix the predicate without changing results
acceptance: Plan searches by learner, course and the created_at range, no temp sort
Root cause and evidence in ANSWER.md
